not_visible: I can't see your whole body. Place the phone on the floor, about 2 meters to your side.
not_upright: Stand up a little straighter. Keep your back upright.
back_not_flat: Try to keep your back flat, level with the floor.
head_not_low: Lower your head all the way, so your forehead and nose touch the ground.
pose_ok: Great, that looks right! Hold it…
pose_done: Well done! You can move to the next step.
speech_complete: Well done! You recited Al-Fatihah completely and in order.
speech_missing: Good effort! It seems a few words were missed. Try again, gently:
speech_order: Good effort! Some verses seem to be out of order. Try again, slowly.
finished_title: You completed both rakahs of Fajr practice!
finished_text: May Allah accept from you. Practice again any time.
review_all_good: You got every step right the first time. Well done, and may Allah accept from you.
close_confirm_text: You'll start over from the first step.
explain_standing: Your back was upright and your knees were straight.
explain_ruku: Your back was level with the floor and your knees straight.
explain_sujood: Your head was lower than your hips, so you were down in sujood.
explain_fatiha: You recited all of Al-Fatihah, in the right order.
footer: This app walks you through the whole prayer, but it only checks your posture in standing, ruku and sujood, and — verse by verse — whether the words of Al-Fatihah were said in the right order. It does not assess pronunciation or tajweed, and never rules on the validity of prayer. Your camera and microphone data never leave your device.
footer_no_speech: This app checks your posture in standing, ruku and sujood only. Your recitation is guided, not checked. It does not assess tajweed or rule on the validity of prayer. Your camera and microphone data never leave your device.
checks_speech_on: Checked, verse by verse: that every word of the verse was said, in the right order. Not checked: pronunciation or tajweed.
checks_speech_off: Not checked: your recitation. This step guides you only — recite at your own pace, then continue.
listen_repeat_hint: Recite Al-Fatihah aloud at your own pace, then continue.
setup_side: Place your phone or laptop on the floor, about 2 meters to your SIDE, not in front of you. You keep facing forward as usual.
setup_steady: Lean it against a wall or a book so it stays steady.
setup_visible: Make sure your whole body, from head to feet, is visible on the screen.
setup_sound: Turn the sound ON. In sujood you can't see the screen, so a chime tells you when your position is right.
setup_illustration_alt: Top-down view: you stand on the prayer mat facing forward, and the phone sits on the floor about 2 meters to your side.
prep_subtitle: Six things to get ready. Tap each one when it is done.
prep_note: The app does not check these. They are a reminder for you.
prep_hint: Tick all six to start the training
camera_hint: Phone on the floor, about 2 meters to your side. Listen for the chime: it means your position is right.
camera_starting: Starting the camera and loading the pose model…
camera_denied: Camera access was blocked. Please allow the camera in your browser settings, then try again.
camera_missing: No camera was found on this device.
camera_error: The camera could not be started. Please try again.
mock_no_camera: Mock mode: the camera is off and feedback is simulated.
pose_model_error: The pose model could not be loaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
checks_standing: Checked: your back is upright and your knees are straight. Not checked: hand position.
checks_ruku: Checked: your back is level and your knees are straight. Not checked: hand position (hands on knees).
checks_sujood: Checked: your head is lower than your hips. Not checked: palms, knees, toes, or forehead and nose touching the ground.
figure_seven_points: 7 points touch the ground: 1 forehead and nose, 2–3 palms, 4–5 knees, 6–7 toes.
figure_sitting_foot: The right foot stays upright, with its toes bent on the mat pointing forward.
figure_diagram_title: Seven points that touch the ground
figure_alt_takbir: Side view of a person standing on a prayer mat, both hands raised beside the head with the palms facing forward.
figure_alt_standing: Side view of a person standing upright on a prayer mat, hands folded on the chest.
figure_alt_ruku: Side view of a person bowing, the back level with the floor, legs straight and both palms resting on the knees.
figure_alt_sujood: Prostration seen from the front: the person faces you with the forehead and nose on the mat, a palm flat on the mat on each side of the head, elbows raised and angled outward, knees apart on the mat and the toes of both feet on the mat further back. The seven contact points are numbered 1 to 7.
figure_alt_sitting: Side view of a person sitting on the floor after prostration: back upright, sitting on the left foot laid flat under the body, the right foot upright with its toes bent on the mat, knees on the mat and hands resting on the thighs.
figure_alt_taslim: The taslim seen from behind, so your right is the same as the figure's right: seated with the back to you, the head turns first to the right, then to the left, while the shoulders stay still.
transition_title: On the way to this position, say:
